answer: A hostile operator running 109 aliases as a result needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in copper, expire in sparrow, and dune lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 110 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
